error.EXTENSION_MISMATCH: The file extension doesn't match its actual format.
error.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file can't be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
error.NOT_A_FILE: Folders and special items can't be processed. Choose a file.
error.FILE_EMPTY: The file is empty (0 bytes). Choose a file with content.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large to process.
error.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image has too many pixels to process.
error.TOO_MANY_PAGES: The PDF has more pages than can be processed.
error.PDF_CORRUPT: The PDF is damaged or can't be read.
error.PDF_NO_TEXT: The PDF has no extractable text. It may be a scanned document.
error.IMAGE_CORRUPT: The image is damaged or can't be read.
error.READ_PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to read this file.
error.OUTPUT_DIR_NOT_WRITABLE: Can't save to this folder. Choose another folder.
error.PATH_TOO_LONG: The file path is too long.
error.CLOUD_PLACEHOLDER: This cloud file hasn't been downloaded yet. Download it first, then try again.
error.VIRTUAL_FILE: Items that aren't real files, such as mail attachments, can't be processed directly. Save them as files first.
error.NETWORK_PATH_FAILED: Couldn't access the file on the network location.
error.SYMLINK_LOOP: The symbolic link loops, so the file can't be opened.
error.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The processing engine for this action isn't available.
error.TIMEOUT: Processing took too long and was stopped.
error.WORKER_CRASHED: The processor stopped unexpectedly. You can try again.
error.ANALYSIS_NOT_CONFIGURED: Claude analysis is off or no API key is saved. Turn it on and save a key in Settings › Claude Analysis.
error.ANALYSIS_KEY_INVALID: That isn't an Anthropic API key. Paste the whole key, starting with sk-ant-.
error.ANALYSIS_KEY_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This computer can't encrypt or read the API key with the operating system's secure storage. Try saving the key again.
error.ANALYSIS_AUTH_FAILED: Anthropic refused the API key. Check that the key is correct and hasn't been deleted or restricted.
error.ANALYSIS_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests, or a usage limit was reached. Try again in a moment.
error.ANALYSIS_INPUT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large for Claude analysis. PDFs can have up to 100 pages and 30 MB.
error.ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't reach the Claude API, or it's temporarily unavailable. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.ANALYSIS_REFUSED: Claude declined to analyze this file.
error.ANALYSIS_FAILED: Claude analysis failed. Try again; if it keeps failing, check your account and billing in the Anthropic Console.
warning.OUTPUT_LARGER_THAN_INPUT: The result isn't smaller than the original. You may want to keep the original.
warning.EXTENSION_MISMATCH: The extension didn't match the content, so the file was processed by its actual format.
warning.ALPHA_FLATTENED: Transparent areas were filled with a background colour.
warning.DOWNSCALED: The image was scaled down to fit the output size limit.
warning.PDF_PAGES_WITHOUT_TEXT: Some pages had no extractable text.
warning.DOCX_TEXT_ONLY: The DOCX contains text only. Layout, tables and images aren't reproduced.
warning.DOCX_IMAGE_ONLY: The image was placed in the DOCX as a picture. Text in the image isn't recognised (no OCR).
warning.SKIPPED_SAME_FORMAT: Skipped because the file is already in this format.
warning.ANNOTATION_FONT_FALLBACK: Some characters can't be drawn with the installed fonts, so they may appear as boxes or be missing in the result.
warning.FIRST_FRAME_ONLY: This is an animated image, so only its first frame was used. The other frames aren't in the result.
warning.FIRST_PAGE_ONLY: This file has several pages (images), so only the first one was used. The other pages aren't in the result.
warning.ANALYSIS_TRUNCATED: The answer reached its length limit, so the end of the report may be cut off.
